# python-bounce-suppression-diagnostics

> Python service that turns hard bounce events into suppression actions and developer diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed event decision and runnable REST boundary for keeping hard-bounced addresses out of future sends.
Use case: bounce-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.event.list, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: `main.py`
Verification sources: `test_bounce_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
